{{Top|leg}}
'''Birdseed''' or '''Bird food''' was food&mdash;often varieties of seeds as its name indicated&mdash;eaten by [[Bird/Legends|birds]]. [[Human/Legends|Humans]] generally made or bought bird food to feed to pet birds or use in birdfeeders. Birdseed could be natural or commercial. The choice of what to use as birdseed depended on the [[Species/Legends|species]] of bird being fed.
